topic: How MrBeast Cracked the YouTube Algorithm

youtube.title: How MrBeast Cracked the YouTube Algorithm
youtube.description:
How MrBeast Cracked the YouTube Algorithm: He made the click, then he made them stay.

A giant bright poster leans on a paint table. No letters on it.

A loud door still starves if the room is empty; a true sit still starves if the door is dim

This is an illustrated documentary from How They Took Over.

Educational analysis of a rise to dominance. Not investment advice.

Sources / further reading:
- YouTube Now: Why We Focus on Watch Time (2012)
- On YouTube's recommendation system (2021)
- MrBeast explains YouTube's algorithm at VidCon (2022)
- MrBeast becomes the first individual creator to reach 500 million YouTube subscribers (2026)
- Changes to Related and Recommended Videos (2012)
- A note about recent changes (2012)
- Expanding custom thumbnails to more partners (2012)
- YouTube changes search to rank based on how long users watch videos, not clicks (2012)

Related: A talking gamer sat on the individual throne for almost ten years, with a different kind of sit. That is a different takeover, facing a different camera. This cut stays on the painted card.
